title: The Moving Board Mystery
scenario: A sensor board reports correctly on the bench but loses its signal whenever its cable or enclosure is moved.

evidence_cards.title: Movement log
evidence_cards.detail: Signal loss occurs within one second of cable movement and recovers when movement stops.

evidence_cards.title: Magnified joint
evidence_cards.detail: A fine ring-shaped crack is visible around the connector pin.

evidence_cards.title: Firmware version
evidence_cards.detail: The same firmware has run for six months without a recorded crash.

evidence_cards.title: Enclosure colour
evidence_cards.detail: The enclosure is purple ABS plastic.

allowed_actions.label: Repair the joint and add strain relief

success_conditions: Connect the movement-correlated fault to the cracked joint
Reduce future cable force at the joint

curveball.scenario: After repair, the board is installed on a vibrating platform. The connector sees repeated cable pull unless it is mechanically supported.
curveball.expected_reasoning: Repair restores continuity; strain relief prevents cable forces from repeating the same fatigue mechanism.

expected_reasoning: Movement-correlated loss plus a visible microcrack supports a fatigued joint; strain relief addresses the mechanical cause.
answer_explanation: The relevant observations support repairing the cracked joint and preventing recurring cable stress.
